step1_figure.description: The netlist implements a complete delay-locked loop (DLL) consisting of a phase detector (PFD), charge pump, loop filter capacitor, and a voltage-controlled delay line (VCDL) with replica bias generator as described in Section 19.6.1 (Figs. 19.53, 19.58, and 19.61).

vcdl_delay.description: Total delay through the voltage-controlled delay line under locked condition

equation.explanation: Relates the phase shift between input and output data to the delay through the VCDL.
equation.assumptions: Locked steady-state operation where VCDL delay matches one reference clock period.

sky130_expected.calculation: Designed for a 2 GHz DLL (T_clock = 500 ps). At lock, t_0 matches one period: t_0 = 500 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Proper VCDL operation requires minimum and maximum delays between 0.5*T_clock and 1.5*T_clock (250 ps to 750 ps).

delay_per_stage.description: Nominal propagation delay per differential stage in the 8-stage delay line

equation.explanation: Evenly divides total line delay across the 8 identical delay stages to produce 8 clock phases.
equation.assumptions: Identical capacitive load and identical bias across all stages.

sky130_expected.reasoning: For a 500 ps line with 8 stages, each stage provides 62.5 ps nominal delay.

vcdl_gain_Kv.description: Gain / sensitivity of the VCDL delay to control voltage Vindel

equation.explanation: Derivative of delay with respect to input control voltage.
equation.assumptions: Linear operating region of the voltage-controlled resistor and bias generator.

sky130_expected.calculation: Over Vindel from 0.6 V to 1.2 V (delta = 0.6 V), delay shifts by roughly 400 ps: Kv = -400 ps / 0.6 V = -667 ps/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher control voltage increases I_REF, lowering resistance and reducing delay.

charge_pump_current.description: Charging and discharging current of the charge pump

equation.explanation: Reference current source mirrored into the charge-pump UP and DOWN branches.
equation.assumptions: Mirrors matched and operating in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: The netlist explicitly fixes the bias current I1 = 10 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Specified by 1:1 current mirrors driven by current source I1.

dll_response_time.description: Transient response time of the DLL to a step change in input phase

equation.explanation: Settling time for a first-order loop with capacitor loop filter C1.
equation.assumptions: First-order feedback model where C1 = 5 pF and T_clock = 500 ps.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by loop capacitance, clock period, charge pump current, and delay line gain.

vref_regulation.description: DC regulated voltage at replica node n2 matching Vref

equation.explanation: The self-biased differential op-amp regulates node n2 to match reference voltage Vref (500 mV).
equation.assumptions: High differential gain of the replica amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vref is externally set to 0.5 V; closed loop forces V(n2) ≈ 0.5 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Finite loop gain in the PMOS differential pair allows small millivolt offset.

step3_testbench.description: ngspice testbench for the 2 GHz Delay-Locked Loop (DLL) verifying steady-state locking, VCDL delay, Vref regulation, and charge pump current.
